span.p: Start: Need to triage FortiGate VPN activity for a user or time period

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Define username and or time window for investigation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Filter logs: type=event AND subtype=vpn AND time within selected window

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: For SSL VPN: include SSL VPN session and tunnel events with relevant logid values

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: For IPsec VPN: include IPsec negotiation and tunnel status events with relevant logid values

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Extract fields: date time, user, group, srcip, dstip, eventtype, logid, result, tunnel name

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Filter events by user if specified, else keep all users in the time window

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Group events by user, tunnel name, source IP, and eventtype

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Group by logid and result to see success, failure, and tunnel up or down patterns

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Identify session sequences per user: login, tunnel up, duration, tunnel down

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Check for abnormal login times, burst of connections, or repeated failures

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Review unusual or new source IPs, geolocation, and client systems for the user

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Compare current VPN behavior to historical patterns for this user and or tunnel

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is the VPN activity consistent with normal behavior and known patterns

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Document findings and close as normal or expected VPN usage

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Flag as suspicious, open security incident, and notify the security or network team

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: If suspicious: validate user with IAM or HR, consider temporary VPN or account restrictions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: If confirmed malicious: disable account, revoke sessions, block source IPs, and review firewall rules
